summary: Re-tested the live frontend public routes and requested interaction flows. Loader, Home, Lessons, Pricing, Contact, calculator, required validation, and rating modal passed. Supplied Firebase admin sign-in still fails without visible feedback.

integration_issues.issue: With the credentials from test_credentials.md, Sign in does not reach the dashboard and the catch block renders no error or recovery guidance; failure is silent.

action_items: Expose a visible auth error/recovery message in the Admin login catch path and investigate whether the supplied Firebase account is enabled or valid.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin login catches signInWithEmailAndPassword errors with an empty catch, making Firebase configuration/account failures indistinguishable from a non-responsive button.

success_rate.frontend: 86% (6/7 flow groups passed; admin auth failed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Live URL tested: https://driving-school-demo-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Public loader/home/lessons/pricing/contact passed; calculator changed £370 to £740 at 20 hours; empty contact submit stayed blocked; rating modal opened and closed. Admin route remained on login after 3 seconds with no visible error. Credentials read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
rca of the issue: App.js Admin.login catches all Firebase Auth exceptions and does nothing. The observed state is consistent with invalid/disabled Firebase credentials or an Auth configuration issue, but the UI provides no diagnostic. Add error state rendering, then retest the supplied account and Firebase Auth setup.
